text:
Alex (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: the org shuffle and headcount Qs we didn't get to. I'll drop short answers here.
Mina (People Ops): Are the new role definitions effective today or next pay period? Any retroactive changes?
Alex (CEO): New definitions go live next Monday. No retroactive changes to comp; promotions/offers in flight will be handled case-by-case by People Ops.
Carlos (Head Eng): For the central platform pool, will engineers be transferred permanently or seconded for 3-6 months? What's the expectation?
Priya (VP Product): Most platform moves are expected to be permanent where the work is ongoing. Short-term secondments are an option for specific projects and should be flagged in the OrgOps form.
Ethan (Manager): If my team gives up a headcount to platform, what's the guaranteed backfill window?
Mina (People Ops): We commit to prioritize backfills within the quarter. If we can't backfill, we'll approve contractor coverage for up to 10 weeks and help reprioritize roadmap.
Jules (Recruiting): Can we repurpose open reqs or must we close and open new ones? Any rules on ref bonuses?
Mina (People Ops): You can repurpose reqs when >50% of the role maps to new scope. Referral bonuses only apply to net-new headcount added to payroll, not internal reassignments.
Carlos (Head Eng): Will the hiring bar change to hit timelines faster? We're concerned about coverage.
Alex (CEO): No change to hiring bar. We will provide contractor support and allow accelerated interview cycles for tagged critical roles, but quality standards remain.
Ethan (Manager): Leveling confusion: L4 scope seems to differ across pods. Are we doing a calibration session?
Mina (People Ops): Yes  we have a cross-org calibration on Thursday 9am PT. Invite and a short rubric will be published in #all-hands-docs.
handbook-bot: New doc posted: "Live headcount matrix"  <https://redwood.company/handbook/live-headcount>.
Jules (Recruiting): For urgent infra hires, tag jobs with "infra-priority" in Greenhouse and cc me for extra sourcer time.
Mina (People Ops): If you have edge cases (pending offers, promotions), DM me with subject "URGENT-offer" so we can triage before the new bands land.
Alex (CEO): Thanks everyone. We'll keep updating the handbook and run office hours for managers Friday 2pm PT. Leaving thread open for follow-ups.
